theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_exists_orthonormal_frame_of_finrank_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ V = n → ∃ v : Fin n → Euclid P, Orthonormal ℝ v ∧ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) = V
